displayName: 写し絵 — News→Video Medium (kawaraban's projected-image sibling)
description: A NEWS→VIDEO MEDIUM. Turns a kawaraban :article/面 into a short narrated, multilingual video that LINKS OUT — the 映像 (moving-image) sibling of 瓦版's printed sheet (写し絵 = Edo-period magic-lantern moving-picture show, Japan's pre-cinema projected image). Like kawaraban it is a MEDIUM, never a source (G11): it narrates a :mirror/:actor-event, never an :original. At R0 it is an OFFLINE render-PLAN builder (methods/render_plan.py): it does NOT render and does NOT call a model; live render is G8-gate...
